Confirmed — selecting items one by one accumulates correctly (3 selected, 3 highlighted). Refresh http://maker:4001/bulk.html.

**Please try the new remove-from-all:** Select a couple of bookmarks that share a tag (e.g. two with `reference`). In the action bar you'll now see a second box, **"remove tag from all…"**, next to the add box. Type `reference` — it **suggests only tags that actually exist on your selected items** — and pick it. → The tag is removed from all selected bookmarks at once.

So the bulk bar now lets you, on a selection (or everything in the current filtered view): **add a tag**, **remove a tag**, **mark read-later / read**, **archive**, and **delete** (with batch undo).

Does that complete the bulk-management flow for you?
